Step 3. By the isometric spectral theorem, we decompose \(A_{01360013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the isometric spectral family.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the exponential convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01360011 \cdot C_01360012 \cdot C_01360013\).
